en: and the Dyad on Mental Concomitance (*Cittasahabhūduka*).

Dependent on a non-demonstrable and non-reactive state that is co-nascent with consciousness, there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor non-reactive and not co-nascent with consciousness, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
There are six [conditions] under root; three under object ... pe ... six under non-disappearance.
